_about: Topic lists for the Edexcel maths banks, in the shape spec.py writes for AQA ({spec: [{code, title, level, text}]}). Maths follows the 9MA0 specification's numbered topics (Pure 1-10, Statistics 1-5, Mechanics 6-9). Further Maths follows 9FM0's papers: Core Pure, then each option paper's topics. Codes are ours (E.P.2 = Pure topic 2); 'text' is a short summary used only for tagging.
